coverage.masks: All q in [2,36], all 8 edge-presence patterns, all q^3 one-coordinate plus-label triples.
coverage.graphs: 360 seeded complete inputs of sides 1..6, dimensions 1..3, twelve listed composite moduli, independent randomized capped witness subsets; ordinary and dense-gauge quotient modes.
coverage.exponents: Exact rational ledger for every M in [2,2048].

scope: Actual delivered archive clean build/render/reproduction; not a new math or novelty verdict.
